comment: Which KMS customer master key gates each enclave, and which committed measurement manifest its kms:RecipientAttestation:ImageSha384 condition must equal. scripts/check-nitro-measurements.mjs compares the two and fails closed. An enclave with no published pin belongs in `unpublished` with an owner and a date; absence without a record is a hard failure. See README.md in this directory.

unpublished.reason: The key policy of alias/morpheus-enclave-master has never been exported from AWS account 736326664265 into version control, so the ImageSha384 condition that actually gates kms:Decrypt cannot be diffed against the committed manifest. The two statements in deploy/nitro/KMS-ATTESTATION-DESIGN.md disagree about what is live: :21-23 says the condition is pinned to the PCR0 of oracle-enclave-exec-2026-06-15.9 (842f4f53...), :71-72 says it is still the all-zero placeholder. Only the exported policy settles which is true, and until it is committed the measurement pin in apps/web/lib/nitro-measurements.ts rests on an unreadable AWS condition.
unpublished.blocked_on: aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/morpheus-enclave-master --policy-name default --output text > deploy/nitro/kms/morpheus-enclave-master.policy.json, then add the matching entry to `pins`
unpublished.owner: neo-os-services platform operator (KMS read on account 736326664265)

unpublished.reason: No custody EIF has ever been built from this tree on a Nitro host. deploy/nitro/measurements/ holds nine manifests and every one is app_id morpheus-oracle, so build-custody-eif.sh:39 has never written measurements/<release>.json. Real PCR0/1/2 for the custody image can only come from `nitro-cli build-enclave` on the Nitro box; inventing them here would produce exactly the unverifiable pin this file exists to prevent. Until then the enclave holding every private key publishes no measurement at all, and workers/neo-signer/src/attestation.rs:9-20 delegates its identity gate to a KMS policy that is likewise unpublished.
unpublished.blocked_on: bash deploy/nitro/build-custody-eif.sh on the Nitro host (reproducibility verification is now the default), then commit the generated manifest and export the custody CMK policy beside it
unpublished.owner: neo-os-services platform operator (Nitro host + KMS read)
